name: Secret Art: Surge of Elements
description:
You channel all masteries of the elements and fire a barrage of elemental bolts at the target.

You make 7 light attacks, doing Arcane, Fire, Water, Frost, Wind, Lightning and Earth damage respectively.

Overcharge: You may spend one more mana to make additional Light attacks, one that does Holy damage and one that does Dark damage.

name: Secret Art: The Grand Theater
description:
All allies within range may sidestep up to their movement speed.

You may Sidestep all enemies within range up to their movement speed.

After all targets have moved, everyone that was originally in range of this ability immediately gains 2 AP they must spend on attacks against other creatures if possible.

name: Secret Art: Titan Blade
keywords: Sure Hit, Full Pierce, Secret Art, Scatter
description:
You greatly increase the size and weight of your weapons, then slam them down in a direction. You make a melee Heavy attack against all enemies in a 15ft wide line up to the range. On damage, a target is knocked prone.

 

After the initial hit, a shockwave follows. You make another Heavy attack against any enemy still in the original line’s range. This second attack has the Sure Hit and Full Pierce qualities against a prone target.
requirement: Must be wielding two Two-Handed melee weapons.

name: Secret Art: Transmute Proto Armatae
description:
You touch the ground, transmuting a Proto Armatae of your own design.  The Proto Armatae lifts you up and immediately encases you into its cockpit.   The Proto Armatae is 15ft tall and is a large creature that occupies a 15ftx15ft space.  All creatures and moveable objects surrounding the Proto Armatae are pushed back away from its zone of control in a burst of steam.  The Armatae also gains a temporary shield with 20 HP that disappears at the start of your next turn.

You must use your own actions to cause the Proto Armatae to move and attack.  You can eject from a transmutation hatch on the top at the center of the Proto Armatae for 1 AP, in which the Proto Armatae stops functioning.  When you re-enter you must close the hatch for 1 AP before the Proto Armatae functions again. 

The Proto Armatae has health equal to 15 + 5x Focus and it uses your AP and RP for actions.  You can channel your Transmuter abilities through the Proto Armatae, and Transmute Weapon can create a giant sized weapon for the Armatae to use.

You may also spend 1 RP to use this ability instead of the AP cost.

Only usable once.  You regain the use of this ability when you gain an Interlude Point.

 

Proto Armatae

HP: –

Evasion: 9/19

Guard: 4/14

 

Mini Transmutation Cannon (Right Arm)

Cost: 0 AP

Range: 40ft

Description:  Fires a mini transmutation cannon of deconstructive energy making a light attack against a target.  Doesn’t provoke attacks of opportunity.

 

Humanoid Gripper (Left Arm)

Description: Humanoid Gripper can make all basic attacks. It is proficient in any transmuted weapon it holds. Its regular melee attacks deal physical damage and any transmuted weapon it wields gains the benefit of that weapon category.

name: Secret Art: True Serenity
description: You enter the Serene Water stance and gain an additional +17 bonus to your Evasion until the start of your next turn.

name: Secret Art: Tsubame Gaeshi
keywords: Lock On, Secret Art, Sure Hit
description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target 3 times. On the first miss, the next attacks gain Lock On. On the second miss, the next attack gains Sure Hit. These only apply to attacks made during Tsubame Gaeshi.
requirement: Katana only.

name: Secret Art: Ultimate Spell
description: The next Spell you cast this turn with an AP cost lower than 5 deals true damage.

name: Secret Art: Unholy Strength
description:
You Gain Unholy Strength which grants +2 Power and Focus. While Unholy Strength is active your attacks/abilities that use your melee weapon to deal physical damage inflict Dark Damage instead and your Bone Armor will not break from damage. 

Upkeep: 1 Mana.

name: Secret Art: Unstoppable Onslaught
keywords: Secret Art, Sure Hit, Mind Affecting, Fear, Challenge, Shaken
description: You may move up to your speed in a line. All enemies you pass through and all enemies within 15ft of your ending position take Light damage, become Challenged and Shaken until the start of your next turn.
requirement: Must be mounted.

name: Secret Art: Vanishing Thousand Steps
description:
You may sidestep to a target within range and make a Heavy attack against them. 

Then, until the end of the turn, you may Sidestep to any enemy you can see as part of a melee attack you are about to make. You gain Windflow stacks as if you spent AP on the movement equal to the AP spent on the attack.

name: Secret Art: Void
description: You target one buff or passive effect you can identify from a grunt or heroic target within range. It is immediately removed and cannot be re-applied for the rest of the encounter.

name: Secret Art: Walking Church
description: Blesses the target, granting them the status of a church. Until the end of your next turn, the target gains Damage Reduction 1000 against all damage types.

name: Secret Art: Whirling Death
description:
You enter the Whirling Death stance, spinning wildly and shooting at enemies within range. While in this Stance you may spend 2 AP to make a basic Light Attack with a pistol against all enemies within 20ft.

When you kill an enemy or make them enter the downed state from with this attack, you may repeat the attack.

The Stance lasts until you enter a different Stance or until you make an attack that is not tied to this ability.

name: Secret Art: Whiteout
keywords: Encounter Start, Frost, Spell, Upkeep, Concentration, Secret Art
description:
You create a sudden snowstorm that obscures sight, creating difficult battle conditions. 

Attack accuracy for all affected units is reduced by your Focus and sight range is reduced to 60ft. A creature can only target something within their sight range.

You and creatures with Frost Immunity are not affected by this ability.

You may activate this ability as an Encounter Start action during the Encounter Start phase of an encounter. If you do, you do not pay the RP or initial mana cost.

Upkeep: You must pay 2 mana at the start of your turn or the effect ends at the end of that turn.

name: Secret Art: Within This Ink, The Perfect Answer
description:
You draw and immediately use a special talisman.

This talisman may have any spell in the base game on it (meaning it’s on the website), though it cannot be a secret or esoteric art. Any costs for this spell must be paid as normal. You must pay the required calligraphy units as if you made the spell yourself. If you can’t pay the required amount, you go into ‘debt’. While in debt, you cannot create any more talisman or use this ability.

To clear the debt, you must pay the required amount of calligraphy units at any point.

After you use this ability, you cannot do so again until the end of the arc.

name: Secret Talisman
description: You use a talisman you possess that contains a Secret Art. This functions like using a normal talisman. You may only use this once per encounter. Does not count towards your Secret Art usage for this encounter.
requirement: Special

name: Seismic Reversal
description:
You grab the target’s weapon or arm and pull it anywhere adjacent to you before slamming the target to the ground and knocking the target Prone.

Does not work against targets more than 1 size larger than you.

If a target defies your Mandate and is within 10ft of you, you may use this on them after their attack is resolved.
requirement: You reduced the damage of a melee attack against you to 0.

name: Seismic Shove
description: You make a Light attack that deals Earth damage against the target. On damage, you may push the target 5ft in any direction.

name: Selective Casting
description:
For the next Spell you cast, you may choose to have it not affect a number of targets you can see equal to your Focus.

Only affects spells with an instantaneous effect (excluding setup things). Lingering spell effects such as Glittershards cannot be used with Selective Casting.

name: Send To Armory
description:
You touch an item not held or carried by another creature and immediately teleport it to your Dimensional Armory into an unoccupied space (if there is room).  If there is no space the spell fails.  Some magic items can be rejected by the dimensional armory.  Living creatures cannot be teleported into the Dimensional Armory.

Overcharge: You spend 1 minute instead of 2 AP, reducing the mana cost by 1.
requirement: You have a Dimensional Armory active.

name: Sense Magic
description:
You can detect active magical effects that aren’t hidden within range.

Hidden magical effects may require a Perception or Insight check.
requirement: None

name: Separate wheat from chaff
keywords: Killing Blow, Fear, Mind Affecting, Scatter
description: You make a Light attack against all enemies in range. On damage, you push the target back 5ft. If you landed a Killing Blow, all that took damage become Shaken as well.
requirement: Scythe only

name: Serene Water Stance
description: You enter the Serene Water Stance. While in this Stance, you gain a +3 bonus to your evasion and you may move 5ft everytime an accuracy check against you misses. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity. This Stance lasts until you enter a different Stance, you use the Block action or until you move, with the exceptions of this ability and movement abilities with the Unarmed Strike keyword. Making an attack does not cancel this Stance.
requirement: An attack against you misses.

name: Shade Form
description: You become like a shade becoming near weightless and gaining the ability to pass through spaces occupied by other creatures. You can also slip through small cracks in walls or doors, as long as they are at least 1inch wide and tall. Upkeep: You must pay 2 mana at the start of each turn or this ability ends. During the night, the mana cost and Upkeep of this is reduced by 2.

name: Shadow Cloak
description: You cloak yourself in Shadows, giving you a +5 bonus on Stealth checks for 1 hour or until end of encounter. It also allows you to hide even when not behind cover or concealment. During the night, the mana cost of this is reduced by 2.

name: Shadow Counter
description:
You prepare a powerful heavy attack against a single enemy. This attack deals extra damage based on half your missing health.

If that enemy provokes an AoO while you are charging this ability, you may immediately use this ability as if you finished charging it.
requirement: Must be in Inexorable Shadow Stance.

name: Shadow Step
description: You may Teleport up to twice your movement speed. During the night, the mana cost of this is reduced by 2.

name: Share Armor
description:
Your ally may treat their guard and block as if they were wearing your armor and shield until the end of the current creature’s turn. If multiple creatures of the same type move on the same initiative, it lasts through all of their turns.

Any temporary increases to the guard/block of this armor (such as through reinforce armor) is not transferred over. Any increases from armor plates or cloak are also not carried over. (But the target's own plates or cloak may apply.)
requirement: Must be wearing armor.

name: Shared Defense
description: Your mount (the last mount you were riding on this arc) may use your defenses instead of its own while within range. In addition, you may spend RP for it while dismounted if your mount is in range.
requirement: Must be dismounted.

name: Shatter
description: Every enemy within range must make a save against your Potency or take Light Damage. Any unattended objects made of glass or a similar vulnerable material also shatter.

name: Shatter Time
description:
For this encounter you may act during different parts of a round. When you end your turn with AP remaining, you may choose to act immediately after another creature ends their turn. You do not regain AP or RP and these extra actions are not considered turns. You may take these extra actions multiple times during a round, provided you have AP remaining.

You cannot use Setup abilities or abilities with the Active keyword during these extra actions.

name: Sheet Ice
description: You freeze the ground in a 20x20 area, creating difficult terrain that lasts until the end of your next turn.  You may use 1 mana per instance of this spell to continue the effect until the end of your next turn.

name: Shelter
description: The attack targeting your VIP instead targets you. You may use this even if you’re also a target of the attack and both attacks will resolve against you. You also gain the benefits of the Block action against the triggering attack.
requirement: Your VIP is the target of an attack.

name: Shield Burst
description:
You heal the target for an amount equal to half the temporary HP they have, then all temporary HP on them is removed. All enemies within 5ft of the target must make a save against your Potency or be pushed back 10ft.

You may use 1 AP instead of 1 RP for this ability.
requirement: Target must have temporary HP that cost mana to apply or was applied by a Shieldwarden or Veilguard ability. This temporary HP must have been applied by you.

name: Shield the Fallen
description: You give the ally temporary HP equal to the damage they would take from the attack.
requirement: Downed ally takes damage from an attack.

name: Shieldcrusher
description: You make a Heavy attack against the target. If they Block against this attack and are wielding a shield or greatshield, that shield becomes Broken.
requirement: Two-handed weapons only.

name: Shooting Form
description:
You transform a melee weapon you’re holding into a Wand Channeling Weapon or return a transformed weapon back to normal. While transformed, the weapon keeps any relevant enchants and functions exactly like how a wand would. You are considered proficient in this wand, even if you normally wouldn’t be and can fire Arcane Elemental shots with it, even if you normally wouldn’t be able to.

Lasts until the end of the encounter, for 5 minutes or until the weapon leaves your possession.

name: Silentium
description: You infuse a light thrown weapon with Sacred Power and Light Attack the target for Light Holy Damage. On damage the weapon disrupts the target’s magic circuits, breaking concentration and preventing the target from using abilities with the Spell keyword. The lodged weapon can be removed for 1 RP or 2 AP, removing the disruption. Combo: If used after Eagle’s Hunt, reduce the AP cost to 0 from 2.
requirement: One-handed Thrown Weapon or Sets of missiles Only.

name: Single-Minded Fury
description: You choose a single enemy as the target of your Single-Minded Fury. Your movement speed is doubled when moving towards your target plus you gain immunity to Slowed and difficult terrain. You also gain immunity to any mind-affecting effect that would prevent you from chasing or attacking your target. You gain a 1d4 bonus to accuracy rolls against that target, but suffer a 2d4 penalty to accuracy rolls against any other target. This effect lasts until the end of the encounter or until the target falls to 0 HP or lower.
requirement: In Rage Stance, ability is not already active.

name: Singularity Collapse
description: You target a 25x25 square and all creatures within that square must make a save or be pulled 10ft towards the center.

name: Siphon Material
description:
Errand. You siphon the alloyed material from an item if possible, removing the effects that the original item would’ve had. If you cannot remove the effect then the skill fails. 

You remove the alloy and regain its original form, while also maintaining the form of the item minus the effect. The special material is retrieved in raw units.

name: Siren Song
description:
All enemies in range must make a save against your Potency. If they fail, they may only spend AP on their next turn to move closer to you using the most direct path possible and cannot make attacks before that. To move closer, they may take actions that would help in getting closer such as standing up from prone or using fae flash. 

If this path leads them through an obviously harmful hazard such as off a cliff, they are no longer affected by this ability. Otherwise, this ability lasts until they are within 5ft of you or until they take damage. While playing this Song, you can take no other actions. Taking any other action cancels the Song, immediately freeing all enemies from its effects. A creature can only be affected by this ability once per encounter.

name: Skillfull Blow
description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target.

name: Skydive
description: You target an enemy below you, no more than 5ft away from you horizontally. You then immediately dive down to that target, making a Heavy Attack against them. You deal an additional point of damage for every 10ft you fell before making the attack, up to 10 extra damage.
requirement: Must be airborne, polearm only.

name: Slam
description:
You attack a single target for Light Damage. On damage, the target is moved 5ft away from you if they are a Grunt or if your Power is higher than theirs, in addition the target must be no more than one size larger than you.

You may spend 1 Mana to ignore the Power requirement.

name: Slide & Shoot
description:
You slide forward up to 20ft towards your target. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity and you may pass through enemy space while moving. At the same time, you may make a Light Attack with your pistol against the target at any point during this movement.

Your next ability gains Combo: If this attack is an unarmed attack, its AP cost is reduced by 1.
requirement: Pistol only.

name: Slime Body
description: You gain Slime Body, which gives Damage Reduction 100 against physical damage against the next attack.

name: Slow
description: The target is slowed until the start of your next turn unless the target pays 1 RP to resist this effect.

name: Smash through the pain
description: You gain Smash through the pain, which reduces the damage taken by the next attack by an amount equal to 3 + Power

name: Snack Time Everyone!~
description:
You present a tray of refreshing Health and Mana snacks to your allies. All allies within 5ft of you may spend 0 RP to eat a snack.

Health: The ally may spend 2 Mana to heal for 15 HP.

Mana: The ally recovers 1 Mana. This counts as a character’s one food for the day and a character cannot benefit from this ability if they already had food. Does not count as a meal for the purposes of fending of starvation.

You keep the tray of snacks up for 1 turn and a character walking within 5ft of you while it’s up may also spend the 0 RP to eat a snack. 

Allies may also spend 0 AP to eat another snack. They can do this once per turn.

Upkeep: 1 Mana, you keep the tray up for an additional turn.
requirement: At least 1 hand free

name: Snap Shot
description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target with a ranged weapon or a thrown weapon. You do not add your Focus to the accuracy roll.

name: Snap Shot II
description: You may make a Light Attack against the target. You do not add your focus to this roll.

name: Snatch
description:
You may use this when a target in range uses the interact with object action. If you can hold the object the target is interacting with in one hand, you steal it from them.

Any AP they may have spent on their action is not refunded to them.
requirement: At least 1 hand free.

name: Sneak Attack
description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target.

name: Solar Radiance
description: You shine brightly like the sun in a 60ft radius around you. You cannot turn this off, but you can lower the range to just 5ft. This light counts as sunlight, though any negative effects a creature suffers from it are halved. It also counts as bright light for creatures weak to light.

name: Soul Absorption
keywords: Spell, Dark, Full Pierce, Sure Hit
description: You make a Light Attack against a willing target that deals Light Dark damage. Your next Dark type Spell or Attack other than Soul Absorption gains extra damage equal to damage taken by the target. (Does not stack)

name: Soul Strike
description: After landing a killing blow, you can use Soul Strike once on that target.  If they are still at 0 HP or less, you raise an orb of divine energy out of the target, killing them instantly.  You then use that orb against a second target, making a light attack that deals dark damage.  It is possible to use Soul Strike while in Cat Form. Overcharge: You may spend 1 extra AP to instead make a heavy or precise attack.
requirement: You land a killing blow.

name: Soulreap
description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target. On Killing Blow, you instantly kill the target and immediately cast Raise Undead on the target for 0 AP.

name: Sound the retreat
description: You sidestep 4 times your speed, moving as far away from visible enemies as possible. After that, your allies may sidestep up to twice their speed towards you.

name: Speak with dead
description:
You attempt to communicate with the soul of a person who has died recently. This requires you to perform a ritual that takes an hour, that must be performed next to the corpse or where the person died. You must be aware of the identity of the person you’re trying to contact. Finally, you must have a tool such as an ouija board that allows the spirit to communicate with you.

Even if the ritual succeeds, the spirit is not forced to answer your questions if hostile to you or it might answer in cryptic ways.
requirement: Special

name: Spear Charge
description:
You may spend 2 or 4 AP on this ability and move as though you had spent that AP on movement. After you finish moving, you may spend half of the AP you used on this ability on a single Light or Heavy attack.

For every 10ft moved, this attack gains +1 damage up to a maximum of +10.

If you spent 4 AP on this ability, you may also choose to use Wild Thrusts instead of making a Light or Heavy attack. These attacks only gain the damage bonus listed above for the initial attacks (and not the constant attacks of opportunity) and Wild Thrusts mana cost is reduced to 0 if used in this way.
requirement: Polearm only.

name: Spellblade's Preparation
description:
You unsheathe a melee weapon and enchant that weapon with an element you've mastered. Your weapon now deals the chosen element’s damage instead of its normal damage.

If you are not holding the enchanted weapon at the start of your turn, your weapon loses this benefit.

The weapon gains a +1 Power bonus to attacks until the end of the encounter.

name: Spellsteal
description: You attempt to steal an effect from the target, removing it from the target and applying it to yourself for the same duration, provided you meet the requirements (if any). You must pay mana equal to the effects original mana cost. Effects granted through stances, transformations and permanent effects cannot be stolen. After stealing an effect, you can’t use this again until the stolen effect has ended. The stolen effect also cannot be re-applied on the target until it has faded from you. You must have seen the effect be applied or otherwise identified an effect before you can steal it.

name: Spellstrike
description:
You choose an ability with the Spell keyword that you can use. You make a melee attack against a target in range for the same AP and mana as the Spell. 

Your attack functions like the chosen Spell does, but does not provoke an Attack of Opportunity and is not treated as casting a Spell (meaning it can be used while Raging and Anti-Spell effects don't work). If the chosen spell was an AoE effect, the target point would be the target you strike with the spell. The requirements for applying any effects remain the same. 

The spell you chose cannot be used again in the same round like normal, and if used with Secret Arts it counts as your Secret Art use for that encounter.

Only works with Spells that are attacks.

name: Spider Climb
description:
You do not suffer any penalties from moving across webs, either natural or created through magic or items. You may climb up walls without using any tools or making any checks at half your normal movement speed and can remain attached to the wall.

If you take any action other than moving or climbing, you become vulnerable to be knocked off the wall you're climbing until the start of your next turn. When you take damage, you slide down 20ft. If you are hanging on a ceiling or similar surface, you instead fall down from it falling prone and taking fall damage as normal.

name: Spike Field
description:
You create a 20x20ft field of spikes. Any creature moving more than 5ft per movement action across it takes full pierce damage equal to your Focus for each 5ft they move across the field.

If the movement through it was forced movement, you only take the damage once.

Lasts until the start of your next turn.

Upkeep: 1 mana, extends the duration of the spike field by 1 turn.

name: Spiked Armor
description: Until the start of your next turn, the spikes on your armor and shield reflect damage when you are attacked. When an enemy hits you with a melee attack, they take 4 full pierce damage.
requirement: Must be wearing armor and/or a shield.

name: Spirit Circuit Crash
description:
You send a wave of magic energy onto the target, afflicting them with Spirit Circuit Crash— jamming their Spirit Circuits.  The target cannot use Secret Arts or any abilities that require mana until the end of their next turn.  The target may choose to take damage equal to your heavy attack damage to cancel this effect.

You can cast this through a creature affected by Mind Connection.

name: Spirit Jump
description:
You and your mount jump up to 60ft vertically straight up into the air.  You can additionally move 5ft horizontally afterwards.  Unless your mount can fly, you automatically land straight down from your position at the end of your turn or for 0 AP, this falling movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity and you do not take fall damage from it.  You cannot make any non-teleport movement actions while in the air, but can still take other actions (such as attacking) while airborne.

You may trade height to move horizontally as part of the initial jump, moving 5ft horizontally as part of the jump in exchange for 5ft of height. You may move up to 40ft extra horizontally with this.

Instead of spending mana, you may instead spend a minute preparing this ability before activating it. When you do, this ability costs 0 mana.
requirement: Must be mounted.

name: Spirited Bravado
description: When you are under the effect of Tipsy, you gain a Spirited Bravado which grants +1 Power.

name: Spiritual Reading
description:
You are able to check the aura of a creature or object within range. 

If you check a creature, you can see whether a creature is non-heroic, weaker than you, around the same as you, stronger than you or much stronger than you. The GM may also give you their Spirit Core value if it has one. You also are aware if someone is concealing their spirit core level, but can’t get an accurate reading of their strength if they are. In addition, you are able to see their mana % until the end of the encounter.

If you check an item, you can determine whether it’s magical in nature. If it is, you may immediately make a Magic check against it to determine its effect as if you were using Decipher Magic with a +5 bonus.

name: Spiritual Sync
description:
If you paid mana for this ability, you gain Temporary HP equal to 8X. Any Temporary HP from this ability remaining after the encounter conclusion phase is turned back into mana at a ratio of 8 Temporary HP to 1 mana.

You may instead pay HP for this ability. If you do, you gain 1 Temporary Mana for every 8 HP you spend. You cannot spend more HP than you currently have. Any Temporary mana is lost at the encounter conclusion phase.

You may spend a maximum of 3 mana or 24 HP on this ability.

Once you use this ability, you may not use it again until after an encounter conclusion phase.

name: Spore Burst
description: You create an explosion of spores in front of you. Make a Heavy Attack against the target that deals Poison damage. Afterwards, knock back the target 5ft and knock yourself back 5ft. This Spell does not trigger attacks of opportunity.

name: Spore Symbiote
description: You send a Spore Symbiote to an ally or yourself.  The Spore Symbiote lasts until the end of combat, or you move it to another target (You can only have one Spore Symbiote active at a time).  If the host of Spore Symbiote moves more than 240 feet away from you, the Spore Symbiote ends.

name: Squadsight
description: An ally that can see or hear you within range may use your Perception score until the start of your next turn. They may also see from your position rather than their own and they may calculate their ranged weapon range (but not LoS) from your position instead of their own. This new range may not exceed twice their normal range.

name: Stab & Throw
description: You may make a Heavy Attack against a target in melee range. You may then use the same weapon to Heavy Attack a different target within your ranged weapon range or thrown attack range. This second attack does not provoke attacks of opportunity from the target of your first attack.
requirement: Throwing Weapon, Set of Missiles or Thrown attack only.

name: Stable Foundation
description: Make a crafting check, afterwards all future crafting dice for this session cannot roll below a 3.
requirement: Must be the first crafting dice in a crafting session. Costs 1 Crafting Dice

name: Staggering Slice
description:
You make a Light attack against the target. On damage, you inflict Stagger 1 until the end of your next turn..

If you're under the effects of Exposing Edge, you inflict Stagger 2 on damage instead.
requirement: One-Handed weapons only.

name: Stalks of Comparison
description: Make a gathering check and apply it to either Node Points or Lucky Points. If the result of this check (before bonuses) is higher than your previous roll this session, gain a bonus to the result equal to your Foraging skill (max +10).
requirement: Costs 1 Strike Dice

name: Stardust Reverie
description:
Declare a distance up to the range of this spell. You create a celestial dome at that range from you that harm those that pass through it.

Until the start of your next turn, whenever a creature willingly enters that distance from you, you may make a Light attack against them that deals Arcane damage. You may choose to spend an RP before making this attack to make it a Heavy attack. A character that Sidesteps or Teleports through your stars does not provoke this attack.

Upkeep: 1 mana. When you pay the upkeep cost, you may change the distance of the stars.

name: Starfall
description:
You target a 25x25 square within range. On the start of your next turn, 4 stars fall down in the area.

At the start of your next turn, you make 4 light attacks that deal Arcane damage, evenly divided amongst enemies in the area. If there are less enemies than stars, you may hit an enemy more than once (though you must still attempt to hit each enemy an equal amount of times if possible).

name: Starlance
description: You make a Precise attack against the target that deals Arcane damage.

name: Start Dash
description: You move up to your speed.
requirement: Must be the first action in your turn.

name: Stasis
description: You put a Grunt level character or any willing ally into Stasis until the start of your next turn. While in Stasis, they cannot be affected by any ability, attack or anything similar but they also cannot take any actions.

name: Static Discharge
description:
A single target in range must make a save or the Static stacks on them immediately discharge, triggering the Static effect as though it was the end of the target’s turn.

Whether the target succeeds at or fails the save, they lose all Static charges.
requirement: The target must be afflicted with Static you applied.

name: Static Overload
description: A single target in range must make a save or immediately take Lightning damage equal to their Static and become inflicted with Daze.
requirement: The target must be afflicted with Static you applied.

name: Statue Form
description:
You turn yourself into a statue, petrifying yourself and the items on you. While in this mode, you gain a +5 bonus to your guard but cannot take any actions except Block. You may leave this mode by spending 0 AP.

You may rest as normal while in this form. While staying in this form, you do not need to eat.

You gain a +10 bonus to your Deception for convincing others that you are just a statue.

name: Status Assessment
description: You can assess the approximate HP percentage of a unit until the end of combat. (The DM should enable health bars for the unit). You can also determine which parts of a creature can be targeted and destroyed, if any.

name: Status Assessment II
description: You can assess the approximate HP percentage of a unit until the end of combat. (The DM should enable health bars for the unit). You can also assess any damage type weaknesses and strengths that the enemy has at the current time. You can also determine which parts of a creature can be targeted and destroyed, if any.

name: Status Assessment III
description: You can assess the approximate HP and RP percentage of a unit until the end of combat. (The DM should enable health bars for the unit). You can also assess any damage type weaknesses and strengths that the enemy has at the current time. You can also determine which parts of a creature can be targeted and destroyed, if any.

name: Stay Here With Me!
description:
All allies within range heal for 8 HP.

Upkeep: 1 AP, 2 Mana. When you pay upkeep, you heal all allies for 8 HP again.

name: Steadfast Earth Stance
description:
You enter a stance that grants you the toughness of the earth. You gain a +2 bonus to your guard and a +6 bonus to your Block.

This stance lasts until you enter a different stance.
requirement: Not wearing any armor (including armor plates)

name: Steady Craft II
description: You add a crafting check to the item. The crafting dice is automatically a 7.
requirement: 1 Crafting Dice.

name: Steady Ground
description:
The target gains Immovable until the start of their next turn.

You may also use this for 2 AP instead.
requirement: The target must be touching the ground.

name: Steady Stance
description:
You enter a Stance in which you become Immovable unless the enemy has more Power than you. If they do, you may pay an additional mana to retain the effect against them for that turn if they would prone you or knock you back.

This stance lasts until you enter a different stance.

name: Steal Heart
description:
The target must make a save or become Charmed until the end of the encounter.

If you use this on a Grunt level enemy and you charm them, you may choose their actions when it's their turn in addition to Charm’s normal effect.

You may only have 1 target charmed at the same time.

name: Steal Time
description: You may make a Light Attack against the target. On damage, you inflict Time Stolen, which lowers their Initiative by 1 and you gain Stolen Time, which increases yours by 1. This effect can stack both on you and on enemies.

name: Steel Aura
description: You gain Steel Aura, granting you 3 additional guard, but you can no longer use any RP actions besides Block and actions with the Rage keyword. You can end this effect at any time for 0 RP. This effect ends at the start of your next turn.

name: Stolen Power
description:
Make a Light (1 AP), Precise (2 AP) or Heavy (2 AP) attack that deals Arcane damage against the target. You use their Power for the damage calculation.

This spell does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: Stolen Skill
description:
You may name one skill (such as perception, athletics) and force the target enemy to make a save against your Potency. On failure, you steal their skill points spent into the skill until the end of the encounter or for 1 minute. You gain their skill points they have in that skill to your skill while they lose all of theirs.

Only affects skill points spent, not any other bonuses from abilities or stats.

Can not be used on artisan and gathering skills.

You may only have 1 instance of Stolen Skill active at the same time, but you may choose to drop your current stolen one for 0 AP.

name: Stone Rebuke
description: You make a Light attack against the target. On damage, the target becomes Unbalanced.
requirement: The target has defied your mandate.

name: Stoneskin
description: You gain Stoneskin, which grants +1 guard and +4 block, but also -2 evasion and dodge.

name: Store Time
description: You gain Store Time, granting you 1 extra AP at the start of your next turn.

name: Store/Consume Item
description: You store a consumable item within your body, this item still counts towards weight limits.  Without needing to equip the item, you can consume an item to gain its effects.

name: Strata Cut
description:
You make a Precise attack against the target. 

Combo: If used after Tectonic Overhead, the mana cost is reduced by 1.

name: Stratagem: Lightning
range: All allies in sight, including yourself.
description: All allied units (including yourself) gain +1 to Initiative and may immediately move up to their Speed.

name: Strengthening the Bond
description:
You swap places with a willing ally. This movement does not trigger any attacks of opportunity. You cannot use this ability if it causes an ally unit to occupy an invalid space. Before or after the swap you can take a 5ft step, but the swap must occur.

You may spend either 0 AP or 1 RP to use this ability.
requirement: A willing ally is within 10ft range.

name: Strike of Still Water
keywords: Full Pierce, Sure Hit, Unarmed Strike
description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target.
requirement: Must be in Serene Water Stance.

name: Study Target
keywords: Lock On, Full Pierce, Sure Hit, Overcharge, Stealth
description:
Your next basic attack against the target gains the Lock On keyword OR you apply Death Mark to the target.

Overcharge: You may spend 2 additional AP to instead make the next basic attack gain the Sure hit and Full Pierce keywords.

name: Stygian Screen
description: You create a wall of darkness that is 20ft long, 5ft wide and 10ft high. This wall must be a straight line.  This wall blocks line of sight. Targets inside of the wall can only see 5ft away

name: Suckerpunch
keywords: Encounter Start, Sure Hit, Unarmed Strike
description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target. On damage, the target becomes Unbalanced.

name: Sudden Growth
description: You trigger the healing of your Regrowth.
requirement: An ally within range that has your Regrowth has taken damage from an enemy.

name: Summon Animal
description:
You summon a randomly chosen animal to a location you can see within range. The summon does not act by itself, but you may spend AP to make it act. The AP cost for these actions is the same as they would be for you taking the basic actions. (Example, you can spend 2 AP to make the summon do a Heavy attack).

The summon also gains access to the abilities the summoned creature normally has. The costs for these have to be paid by you, same as they would be for basic actions. Any attacks it makes are made with its own stats. When an animal summoned through this ability dies, you cannot use this ability again until the end of the encounter. You can undo the summoning manually for 0 AP.

The pool of creatures that can be summoned is the following: Wolf, Boar, Giant Spider.

name: Summon Lesser Eidolon
description:
Your contracted Eidolon hears your call and sends their minions to fight for you. The summon called and costs are dependent on your attunement. Lasts up to 5 minutes. You must pay the upkeep cost under the Summon’s Summon Skill or the Summon vanishes.

Unless the summon has a skill that says otherwise, a summon acts after you on initiative, but cannot act the round it is summoned except for RP actions.

name: Summon Piece
description:
You summon a Pawn puppet under your control. It (and other puppets from this class) have HP equal to 20 + Focus, no evasion and no guard. These puppets are not living targets and are generally treated as structures rather than creatures.

They last until the end of the encounter.

Overcharge: You may spend extra mana to summon the following puppets instead:

1 Mana: Knight or Bishop

2 Mana: Rook

3 Mana: Queen

name: Suppressive Fire
description:
You make 5 light attacks divided against enemy targets in a 25x25ft area.

Afterwards, all enemies that you damaged are treated as blinded 2 when making ranged attacks and you may make a ranged weapon light attack against them each time they do. If they walk out of the 25x25 area, they are no longer affected by this.

These effects lasts until the start of your next turn.
requirement: Must be made with a pistol, musket or crossbow.

name: Swallow Acrobatics
description: Your next movement before the end of your turn does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
requirement: Can be used after you make a melee attack while flying.

name: Swap
description:
You Swap positions with a chosen willing ally or any non-heroic enemy.

You may use either AP or RP for this ability. You don't need to pay the cost of both.

name: Sweeping Stance
description:
You enter a stance in which you spin your weapon around in a circular motion and lash out against any enemy that approaches. When an enemy enters your weapon’s range you may make an Attack of Opportunity against them. An enemy moving while already being in your attack range does not provoke. Your weapon's range for these attacks of opportunities is increased by 5ft (This does not affect your normal threaten range).

The stance lasts until you make an attack that isn’t an Attack of Opportunity.
requirement: Two-handed weapons only.

name: Sweet Dreams
description:
As a rest action, you may choose an ally other than yourself to heal for 5 + Toughness after their rest has finished.

Doesn't stack with Medical Kit.

name: Swift Wind Palm
description:
You make a Light attack against the target. On damage, the target is knocked down 30ft or until they hit the floor (on top of any other height loss from being hit while flying) and you may Sidestep next to them afterwards. 

A target knocked down on to the ground with this ability is knocked prone and takes falling damage as normal. They do not take the normal extra damage as result of being knocked into the floor.
requirement: You and the target must be airborne

name: Sword Riding Art
description:
You jump onto a light sword, versatile melee weapon, greatshield, bayonet musket or two-handed melee weapon you’re carrying and use it to move around. While riding on top of the sword, you gain Flight. You can fly this way for up to 5 minutes.

If you take damage while flying higher than 5ft above the ground, your altitude drops by 20ft. If this would reduce your altitude to the point where you touch the ground, you may hop off your weapon and put it back into your hand if possible for 0 RP. After this happens, your Sword Riding ends. If the attack that reduced your HP came from a flying creature other than yourself, you do not lose altitude but instead become unbalanced.

If you are knocked back by an effect, you must make a save against the attacker's potency. Else, you are blown off your sword.
requirement: Must have a Light Sword or two-handed melee weapon in your hand.

name: Tackle
description: You attempt to tackle the target and may make a Heavy Attack against them. This attack deals no damage. On hit and if the target did not use the Block action against this ability, you and the target fall Prone. If the target successfully dodges this ability, you fall Prone.

name: Tag Rotation
range: Two ally units, or yourself and an ally unit  that are adjacent to each other that you can see.
description: The target willing allies, or yourself and a target willing ally switch places.  This movement does not trigger any attacks of opportunity.  You cannot use this if it causes an ally unit to occupy an invalid space. You may use either AP or RP for this ability.

name: Tailwind
description: You and all allies within 40ft gain Tailwind, which provides a +1 bonus to initiative and doubles movement speed in the first round of combat.

name: Take Cover!
description: All Low Cover in a 20x20 area becomes High Cover for your allies (including yourself).  This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

name: Take it easy
description: Do not make a gathering check. Instead, immediately collect 25% of the Outcrop’s base material as a bonus (doesn’t affect material totals), but no Node or Lucky progress is made.
requirement: Must in a gathering session.

name: Take Off
description:
Immediately mount and blast off into the sky equal to double your movement. 

Cannot be used if you are the target of an attack during the Encounter Start round.
requirement: Aerial Stave in Combat Inventory

name: Talisman Recursion
description:
After using a Talisman, you may immediately spend the cost of that talisman (before reductions) to repeat the effect without consuming another talisman. If the talisman had a target, you must choose the same target.

Does not work with Secret Talismans.

name: Tap Cracker
description:
You open a door or interact with an object remotely.  You can cast this through a creature affected by Mind Connection.  

Overcharge: You can pay 1 mana to magically unlock most doors and objects (DM can decide if an object is too complicated, and still make you roll a Skill Check).
requirement: Object is in a room affected by Psychometry

name: Tectonic Overhead
description: You make a slow, powerful overhead swing and make a Heavy attack against the target. Their evasion (but not dodge) is doubled for this attack.

name: Tempestuous Fire Stance
description: You enter the Tempestuous Fire Stance. While in this Stance, before you make an attack with the Unarmed Strike keyword, you may choose to move 5ft per AP spent on the move. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity. This Stance lasts until you enter a different stance or until you move, with the exceptions of this ability and movement abilities with the Unarmed Strike keyword. Making an attack does not cancel this stance.

name: Temporary Protection
description: Until the end of the encounter, the target ally you selected is also treated as your VIP.

name: Tengu Aura Weapon
description: Your infuse your weapons with fiend killing aura, making them equivalent to Silver weapons for the purposes of harming fiends. Attacking a fiend with a silver weapon disables their regeneration.

name: Tengu Mask
description: You manifest and don a Tengu Mask of your desired design, granting Presence Concealment.   You cannot use any mana abilities or Aura abilities while in Presence Concealment.  You can end this effect for 1 AP or 1 RP, to either remove your mask or to wear it on your head in a way that doesn't cover your face.

name: Terracing
description:
You raise the ground around you in a 25x25ft square centered on yourself. The ground is raised upwards by 10ft. Can only be used on natural ground and cannot be used on ground that’s already been raised.

Overcharge: You may spend 1 AP and 1 Mana to raise it upwards by another 10ft.

name: Tetsuzanko
description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target. This attack deals additional Light Damage added to the Heavy Damage. Combo: If used after an ability that moved the target, you may push the target for an equal distance again.

name: Thanergetic Bloom
description: You summon a temporary Zombie as if you used Raise Undead. It disappears at the end of the encounter (or immediately if used outside of an encounter).

name: Thermal Quench
description: You make a crafting check. For each time you rolled a 5 or higher this craft, this check gains a +1 bonus.
requirement: Must be in a crafting session.

name: Thermal Vision
description: You can perfectly see and detect heat sources up to 120ft away, including stealthed creatures. This cannot detect things hidden by magical means. You can no longer discern a difference in heat once something reaches freezing temperatures.

name: Thick Skull
description: When you would get Dazed, you may make a Save against the effect even if it would normally not allow for one. If you already had to make a save to avoid it, then you don’t get another.

name: This is our moment!
description:
All allies within range gain a +1 Song bonus to their damage rolls. This bonus is doubled on Heavy attacks.

Upkeep: 1 AP

name: Threatening Aura
description: Until the start of your next turn, all enemies in your melee range are considered Challenged by you.

name: Throw Potion
description: You throw a Potion in your hands at a willing ally unit within range. The unit may pay the mana cost (if any) to receive the effect of the Potion.

name: Thunderstorm
description: You may make a Light Attack that deals Lightning damage against all target enemies in range. As the attack comes from the sky, any cover is calculated from above the target rather than from your path to the target.

name: Timberwright's Core Crafting
description:
Carpenter's Modification B
Cost: X Crafting Points
Description: 
You add an B-Type modification to the weapon or tool. See the Universal Weapon page as well as the individual weapon page for details. Each modification has its own cost.

name: Tiny Pixie
description:
Your size is tiny and you are able to occupy the same square as an ally or enemy. Your Toughness is reduced by 2 and your Agility is increased by 2.

When walking (and not hovering or flying), your movement speed is reduced to 5ft.

name: Tireless Undead
description: Jiangshi do not know pain or fatigue, making them terrifying warriors. You are always counted as rested despite the most inhospitable conditions. You also do not need to sleep.

name: Torture Techniques
description: You twist the knife and inflict a debilitating wound on the enemy. You inflict one of the following conditions: Slowed, Unbalanced or Bleeding. These last until the end of the target’s next turn.
requirement: You landed a crit on the enemy (and it wasn't blocked or dodged).

name: Toxic Blast
description: You fire a stream of poison and make a Light attack against the target. On hit, this deals no damage but inflicts the enemy with Toxic, making them take 1d6 full pierce Poison damage at the start of their turn until they spend 2 AP to remove the poison effect.

name: Track
description: You find any tracks that aren’t hidden.  Once you find tracks, you can follow them at normal speed without having to make checks.

name: Trail Mix
description: For a camp action you create up to 5 servings of a trail meal.  It costs 20u of food per serving and only gives 1 mana (0 for Mirane), but it keeps starvation away.  Does not require a culinary kit, and does not count as cooking for the purposes of culinary actions such as using stocks.
requirement: 20u of Food Per Serving

name: Trailblazer
description: You move up to your speed. Any allies within 30ft of where you started moving may spend 1 RP to move up to twice their speed towards you. They ignore the effects of natural difficult terrain for this movement.
requirement: Must be mounted and meet the requirements of your Light Cavalry key ability.

name: Trample
description:
You may activate this after moving at least 20ft in a movement action to gain Trample until you stop moving. Abilities with the Teleport keyword do not apply for this, but declaring multiple AP to move at the same time counts as 1 action. While under the effects of trample, you don't provoke attacks of opportunity by moving and you can move into enemies that are at least one size smaller than your mount. An enemy may spend 1 RP to move out of the way to an empty spot within 5ft of them.

If they don’t move out of the way, you make a Sure Hit Light attack against them with your mount, using your mount’s stats. On damage, you knock them prone into the square you came from and keep moving, occupying the square they were in. Otherwise your movement action ends.

Each enemy can only be affected by trample once per activation of the ability, regardless of whether they are attacked or move out of it.
requirement: Must be mounted.

name: Transfusion
description:
You lose HP up to your Toughness x 2. Target ally within range heals for the same amount of HP you lost.

This HP loss cannot be mitigated in any way and ignores temporary HP. This does not trigger effects that would trigger upon taking damage.

name: Transmutation Basics
description:
Alchemic Catch
Description: 
Co-Craft. Use a hasty transmutation to attempt to fix a crafting error. You may reroll a crafting dice immediately after determining the result. You must keep the second number. Cannot be used for the last crafting dice.

Temperature Shock
Description: 
Co-Craft. Can be used immediately after the result of a roll is determined. The previous action has no effect and instead gain a +10 to your next crafting action.

Rage Quit
Cost: 1 Crafting Dice
Description: 
Co-Craft. Only usable once per crafting IP.  Destroy the uncrafted item and all materials invested into the craft.  You may immediately start another crafting session.  If you use this as a Co-Craft it requires 1 crafting dice from the main crafter.

Bouncing Ideas
Description:
Co-Craft. You assist with crafting adding 1d4 crafting points to the current craft.

Create Ingot
Cost: Errand
Description:
You create an ingot from blacksmithing base materials or from blacksmithing special materials.  See Item:  Blacksmithing Materials.

Create Oil Coating
Cost: Errand
Description:
You create an Oil Coating from Carpenter materials.  See Items:  Carpenter Materials

Create Wood Block
Cost: Errand
Description:
You create a Wood Block from Carpenter materials.  See Items:  Carpenter Materials

Craft Fuel Shells
Cost: Errand
Description: 
You craft up to 5 small shells.  You can instead craft a medium shell instead of 2 small shells.  Small shells require 50 magical fuel, medium shells require 200 magical fuel.

Create Artifice Parts
Cost: Errand
Description:
You create up to 3000u of artifice parts of the same type of blacksmithing material used to make them at a 1:1 rate. (3000u of Iron Creates 3000u of Iron Artifice Parts.)  See Items:  Blacksmithing Materials, Artificer Materials. When converting items of a higher tier, you can convert up to 6000 of tamahagane, 9000 of mithril, 12000 of Orihalcum or 15000 of escudo.

Tan Leather
Cost: Errand
Description: 
You create a tanned hide from armorsmithing base leather materials. See item: Armorsmthing materials.

Create Box or Bundle of Food
Cost: Errand.
Description: 
You create a perfect mix of ingredients that would be worthy of a stock with 500u of matching material.  Example:  500u of Meat can make 1 Box of Fresh Meat.  You can make 5 boxes of any kind for one errand action.

name: Transmute Effective Implement
description:
From the surrounding material you construct an “Effective Implement”, granting you a +5 to the skill of your choice.  You must explain how this implement will be effective towards the check using the relevant skill (example:  creating a springboard to jump higher with athletics) and the GM determines the validity or this ability has no effect.  Does not work with crafting or gathering skills. This implement lasts until you have attempted the specific check it was created for. 

You may also spend 1 RP instead of 1 AP for this ability.

Overcharge:  You can spend 1 additional mana to increase the skill bonus to +10.

name: Transmute Terrain
description:
Creates a connected transmuted terrain that grows from the point of origin.  For every mana spent, you can create up to 4 5ft squares of terrain that must be connected.  Choose solid ground normal terrain or difficult terrain.  Removes effects on the terrain such as ice, fire. The terrain can push objects and creatures in the direction its being created.  If the transmute terrain deals damage to a creature, the spell stops after and the 5ft segment that contacted them is destroyed.  Each segment of wall has HP equal to 20+Focus

Heroics caught in the terrain may spend 1 RP to step out of it. Once they do, they can't be shoved within this use of transmute terrain even if you attempt to hit them with it again.

name: Transmute Wall
description: You quickly transmute multiple walls to defend against an incoming ranged attack.   Each wall you summon reduces the damage of the incoming attack by 2* Focus, you can summon as many walls as you like against the incoming attack for 1 mana per wall. After the attack resolves, every wall you made vanishes regardless of remaining HP.
requirement: You or an ally in range is the target of a ranged attack.

name: Transmute Weapon
description:
Using the available materials around you, you transmute any basic weapon or shield into your hand or next to an ally, your ally can grab the weapon at the time of its creation for 0 RP, as well as sheathe their weapons.  The weapon lasts until the end of the encounter and is destroyed.

You can transmute weapons out of special material if there is enough of it in the area, or if you have one (such as an ingot) but the material is destroyed afterwards.  The DM determines if this is possible in the specific case.
requirement: There is suitable material available. (GM decides)

name: Transmuter Tricks
description:
Stabilize Matter
Description: 
Co-Craft. Use a transmutation that stabilizes the material, making it easier to work with. The next crafting d10 cannot roll lower than a 6.

A Small Bit of Creation
Cost: One herb with a rarity higher than common.
Description:
You deconstruct and reconstruct the structure of an harvested alchemy herb. By lowering its energy level you attune an herb to another element. Choose one herb and lower its rarity by one step and then change its element into the element of your choice.

name: Traveler's End
description:
You play the final tunes of the melody that signals the traveler’s ending. 

While Traveler’s End remains active, the Potency of your Mist of the Vale and Despair of Isolation is increased by 3. Your Mist of the Vale can no longer be removed and any effect that would remove it instead dispels Traveler’s End.

At any point after activating this song, you may spend 1 RP and 5 Mana to make a Sure Hit Heavy attack against all enemies within your Mist of the Vale. On killing blow, you regain 1 mana you spend on the attack (up to 5). Afterwards, the Mist of the Vale ends and cannot be reused in this encounter.

Traveler’s End otherwise lasts until the end of the encounter or until the Mist of the Vale is gone.

Upkeep: 1 Mana
requirement: Mist of the Vale must be active for at least 1 turn.

name: Tremorsense
description:
You become aware of the presence and exact location of any creature within range that is touching the ground until the end of your turn.

Overcharge: You may spend extra mana to increase the range by an additional 40ft per mana spent.

name: Trial By Fire
description:
You make a Light attack against the target. On damage, they are challenged by you until the start of your next turn.

 If this does not deal damage, they cannot be challenged by you until the start of your next turn.

name: True Death
description: Damage from melee weapon attacks made by you also reduces the target’s max HP by the same amount. This lasts until the end of the encounter.

name: True Divine Release
description: You unleash your latent angelic powers and transform into a semi-divine being for up to an hour. While transformed, you gain controlled flight and +5 movement speed. Upkeep: 2 mana After using this ability, you cannot do so again until the interlude rest phase.
requirement: Not already transformed

name: Twin Verdict
description: You make two Heavy attacks against the target.

name: Twinkle Step
description:
All allies within range gain a +1 Song bonus to their Evasion and Dodge.

Upkeep: 1 AP

name: Two Point Strike
description:
You may make a Light Attack against the target. On damage, you apply Wave Palm I. 

Wave Palm increases the mana cost of the afflicted target’s next action that uses mana by an amount equal to the amount of stacks applied. If the triggering attack makes the number of total stacks exceed the target's current mana, they lose mana equal to the amount of total stacks and take true damage equal to triple this amount. Wave Palm does not stack with itself, use only the higher value.

If the target has no mana, they immediately take true damage as if their stacks exceeded their current mana.

When the Wave Palm effect triggers, either by increasing the mana cost or by dealing the true damage, the Wave Palm effect is removed.

name: Two Sword Crush
description: You may add your Light damage to the attack.
requirement: Can be used after hitting an attack with a Two-Handed melee weapon. Must be dual wielding a second Two-Handed melee weapon.

name: Uke Nagashi
description: Roll Heavy Damage and treat that as your Block against the attack that’s targeting you. If you reduce the damage to 0, the attacker becomes Unbalanced. On hit effects and maces do not gain their effect if you reduce the damage to 0. After the attack is resolved, you may immediately make an Iai Strike against the attacker for 0 RP. This Iai Strike gains the Sure Hit keyword against an Unbalanced target.
requirement: Katana only, target of a melee attack and must be in the Iai state.

name: Unconventional Weapon
description: You may treat the weapon you’re currently wielding as a weapon of a different group for the next attack in addition to its normal group. In addition to receiving the base weapon properties of both weapon groups, this allows it to meet the requirements of abilities that require a certain group, and allows you to change its damage type to the chosen weapon’s damage type. The GM may rule that some abilities still cannot be performed with your equipped weapon.

name: Undying Justice
description: If the damage would reduce your HP to 0 or lower, it instead lowers your HP to 1.
requirement: You take damage. Your HP is higher than 1.

name: Unerring Aim
description: When you aim at an object not being worn or wielded within your ranged weapon range, you always hit your target.

name: Unholy Pact
description: You remove your Bone Armor to heal yourself for Power x 2 and gain a +2 Power bonus on your next attack.
requirement: Bone Armor is active on you.

name: Unmake
description: You target one magically created wall or unattended object within range. You instantly destroy a 5x5 square of it or the object entirely.

name: Unmoving Mountain
description:
You let the attack wash over you, not gaining an increase in guard but still allowing you to reduce the damage to 0 if your guard is high enough.

Afterwards if you took no damage from the attack, you inflict Mandate on the target.
requirement: Must be in Earth Stance.

name: Unpetrify
description:
You remove the Petrify condition from a target within range.

If you are petrified, you may use this on yourself despite normally being unable to act.

name: Unrelenting Assault
description:
You may use this ability when an enemy willingly moves out of your melee weapon range to make a Heavy attack against them. You can use this even if they took the disengage action or a similar action that would not make them provoke attacks of opportunity. If the target uses a teleport type move, then you cannot use this ability, unless they Teleport into your weapon range.

This is treated as an opportunity attack.
requirement: An enemy moves out of your range.

name: Unsummon
description:
Unsummon your Eidolon or Lesser Eidolon.  Recover mana equal to half of the mana cost of the summon cost.

You may use this as an Encounter Conclusion action.
requirement: You have an active Eidolon or Lesser Eidolon.

name: Until My Voice Breaks
description:
Whenever you’re about to pay mana on one of your abilities with the Idol keyword, you may instead reduce your current and max HP by 8 for each mana you’d spend.

This max HP reduction lasts until the end of the encounter and cannot be removed.

name: Vampire Bite
description:
You may make a Light Attack against the target. On damage, you drain 1 mana from the target, recovering 1 mana yourself. If the target has no mana remaining, you instead deal an additional Light damage.

This unarmed strike must be made with your fangs, but may be made even with both hands full.

Damage done by this ability also reduces the target’s max HP until the target finishes a rest.

A target reduced to 0 HP by this ability is killed and if the target was a heroic unit, it has a chance (GM’s decision) to turn into a vampire subservient to you.

If the target has any mana remaining and is a willing target, you may choose to not deal damage with this attack.

name: Vampire Shapeshift
description:
You are able to change your form to that of a rat or bat.

While in this form, your size changes to that of the chosen animal and you are treated as a normal animal of that type. You cannot make any attacks or use any abilities while in this form.

You may exit this form at any time for 0 RP.

name: Vampiric Domination
description:
You mentally dominate the target. The target immediately considers you their master and they will serve you like a loyal servant. You may command them and they will obey most commands. Any command that is obviously suicidal or completely goes against their nature (for example: telling a servant to jump off a cliff or to kill their own child) will end the domination prematurely. This effect lasts until dispelled, they die or until you use Vampiric Domination on another target.

After the effect ends, the target will remember everything it was forced to do while it was your servant and it cannot be affected by Vampiric Domination again for a year.
requirement: Target must be under the effects of Vampiric Fascination

name: Vampiric Fascination
description:
You charm a non-heroic creature within range. While charmed, the target must spend its AP during its turns on moving towards you in the most direct path possible while avoiding any dangers it is aware of. If it is already next to you, it instead takes no actions.

At the start of your next turn, you may spend 4 AP to continue the charm. If so, the charm continues until you stop paying the AP cost or until the target takes damage from an attack other than a Vampire Bite.

While you have a target under the influence of Vampiric Fascination, your Vampire Bite costs 0 AP and has Sure Hit plus Full Pierce against that target the first time you use it each turn.
requirement: Target must be able to see or hear you, Target must be non-heroic.

name: Vanish
description:
You gain the Hiding state from anyone you have cover or concealment from.

During the night, the mana cost of this is reduced by 1.

name: Vengeance
description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target. If your VIP is at 0 HP or lower, this attack gains Lock On and Block Crush.
requirement: Your VIP was attacked last turn and you re-directed an attack from them to you or your VIP is downed.

name: Venom Strike
description: You make a Light attack against the target. On damage, inflicts the enemy with Toxic, making them take 1d6 full pierce Poison damage at the start of their turn until they spend 2 AP to remove the poison effect.
requirement: Must be made with a melee weapon or with a Set of Missiles, Throwing Weapon or Thrown attack with small weapon only.

name: Verdant Instinct
description: Make a gathering check and apply it to NP. After rolling, roll two more dice that will be used as your next 2 strike dice values. You may reorder them or replace one with a 5.
requirement: Must be in a gathering session.

name: Victory or Death
description:
All melee weapon attacks that you make this turn deal maximum damage on hit. All weapon attacks made against you until the start of your next turn also deal maximum damage on hit.

Once used, this cannot be used again until the end of the encounter.
requirement: In rage stance.

name: VIP Protection
description:
You change the target of the attack to you instead of your VIP.

This attack automatically hits you and you may not use the Dodge and Block or similar reactions against it. 

The re-directed attack is treated as having most the requirements met as if it was still targeting the original target, including effects that are conditional such as Full Pierce on a downed target, and you are considered to be in the original target's spot for the purposes of range of the attack you're re-directing. 

GM's may rule some conditional effects are based on you rather than the original target, such as attacks with effects based on race.

Does not work against Attacks of Opportunity and cannot be used against an attack that's already redirected.
requirement: Your VIP is within 5ft of you and is the target of an attack that does not target you as well.

name: Vital Drain
description:
You make a Precise Attack against the target creature that deals Earth damage equal to their Toughness with Full Pierce.  On damage the current host of Spore Symbiote is healed for the damage dealt.

Vital Drain can be casted from the location of the host of your Spore Symbiote.

name: Vital Drive
description: You regain HP equal to 5 times the mana spent.

name: Vital Drive II
description: You regain HP equal to five times the mana spent. Vital Drive II cannot heal more than the damage you took from the triggering attack.
requirement: You took damage from an attack.

name: Vivisect
description: You cut the target in half with your scissors or chainsaw, killing them instantly.
requirement: Giant Scissors or Chainsaw only. Target is affected by Expose and is a grunt.

name: Volley
description: You make a Light attack against all targets in a 25x25ft area.

name: Wall Formation
description: Until the start of your next turn, every ally within range gains Wall Formation. If they are adjacent to another ally gains a +1 bonus to their guard and a +4 bonus to their block value.

name: Warm Together
description: When you have “Just A Hug” active. You and the target gain resistance to cold from environmental effects.

name: Warning Shot
description: You fire a warning shot against a target in your range. Your next basic attack or Ricochet ability with a pistol against that target gains the Trick Attack keyword.
requirement: Must be done with a pistol.

name: Weapon Maintenance
description:
You recall having previously assisted an ally in maintaining their weapon, causing it to be in top shape for battle. This weapon gains a +1 Power Material Bonus or +1 Focus Material Bonus. If you smithed the weapon it gains both. This Artisan bonus is considered the same bonus as from a weapon's material like Tamahagane and does not stack with it.

If the weapon you choose gets no bonus from this ability, it's critical range instead improves by 1. (A normal weapon now crits on a 19 and 20, a katana on a 18, 19 and 20).
requirement: 1 Ally’s Smithed Weapon, or your own smithed weapon.

name: Weighing the Heart
description: You get a +5 Expertise bonus to insight checks when looking to discern if someone is lying to you.

name: Weight of the Mountain
description:
You prepare to strike with enhanced power.

Your next attack with a two-handed melee weapon this turn loses the keywords: Lock On and Sure Hit. In addition, you do not gain accuracy from your Focus on the enhanced attack. The attack also cannot benefit from Offstep and similar effects that guarantee the attack hits.

Instead, the attack deals extra damage equal to the accuracy lost from not gaining Focus due to Weight of the Mountain. If the attack is a heavy or precise attack, it deals extra damage equal to double the accuracy lost instead. 

If the attack made with this effect already did not benefit from focus, this ability has no effect.

name: Weight of the World
description: You increase the target’s gravity, reducing their elevation by 40ft. This may interrupt movement and if you reduce their elevation down to 0, you slam them into the ground dealing fall damage for the distance they failed to move and knocking them prone.
requirement: Target enemy is flying or jumping.

name: Whisper of the Streets
description: You recall conversations you had with business partners. This grants you a +5 to any Reason check.

name: White Thunder
description: You target a Glacial Wall in range and fire a bolt of Frost energy that requires line of sight. On impact, the wall is destroyed and explodes into blades of ice, attacking all enemies within 5ft of the destroyed wall with a Precise attack that deals Frost damage. On damage, the target is Slowed until the end of their next turn.

name: Wild Bloom
description: You apply Regrowth to up to 5 (including yourself) allies within range.

name: Wild Thrusts
description:
You rapidly thrust your weapon in front of you, making a Light attack against all enemies in a 15ft wide, 10ft long box in front of you. Until the start of your next turn, you may make Attacks of Opportunity against any enemy walking through that box. You cannot make any other Attacks of Opportunity while this effect lasts.

You may cancel this effect for 0 RP.
requirement: Polearm only.

name: Wind Blast
description: You may make a Light Attack that deals Wind against the target. On damage, you push the target back 20ft. Targets knocked into other characters or an object take damage as if they fell a distance equal to distance they failed to move.

name: Wind Blast II
description: You may make a Light (1 AP), Precise (2 AP) or Heavy Attack (2 AP) that deals Wind damage against the target. On damage, you push the target back 20ft.

name: Wind Buffet
description: You blow wind in a 30ft, 60ft degree cone in your chosen direction. All caught in the cone must make a save against your Potency or be blown back to the end of the cone and knocked Prone. Enemies with a size smaller than you suffer a 1d4 penalty to this roll, while enemies bigger than you get a 1d4 bonus instead. Targets knocked into other characters or an object take damage as if they fell a distance equal to distance they failed to move.

name: Wind Infusion
description: You surround the willing target in protective winds, changing their typing to Wind II. As a Wind II type, they take regular damage from all other elements, but only half damage from Wind or Earth damage or from attacks with the Wind or Earth keyword unless that attack deals true damage. They take 50% more damage from Frost damage or attacks with the Frost keyword. While the ward lasts, they gain a +2 bonus to their Evasion against ranged weapon attacks. The ward lasts until the end of the encounter or until their type is overwritten by a more powerful type.

name: Wind Scatter
description:
You select a point within range. All targets in a 15x15 area must make a save against Potency or be pushed back 15ft away from the point you selected.

Targets knocked into other characters or an object take damage as if they fell a distance equal to distance they failed to move.

name: Wind Shield
description: You grant the target  1 RP that must be spent on the basic Dodge or Block action against the triggering attack as well as Wind Shield. Wind Shield grants a bonus to Dodge equal to your Focus against the triggering attack. The triggering attack can also no longer benefit from Lock On or Sure Hit
requirement: Ally is targeted by a ranged attack.

name: Wind Wall
description: You create a wall of wind that is 30ft long, 5ft wide and 10ft high that slows down all ranged weapon attacks passing through it, treating them as having only half the normal range. This wall must be a straight line. These attacks also lose the Lock On, Sure Hit, Half Pierce, Guard Crush and Full Pierce keywords. In addition, the targets of those attacks are treated as having +2 Evasion and +1 Guard. Any Spells that are considered attacks (those that require an accuracy roll against a person that isn’t using the Block reaction) that pass through the wall also suffer this penalty.

name: Wind-Empowered Aim
description: You project Wind-Empowered Aim aura around yourself that empowers the ranged attacks of your allies. When a heroic ally within 20ft of you (including yourself) makes a ranged attack, they may add 1d4 to the accuracy roll. Upkeep: You must spend 1 AP at the start of each turn or the Aura fades.

name: Wind-up Punch
description: You may make a Heavy attack against the target. Overcharge: You may spend additional AP when using this ability to deal an additional Light Damage per AP used. Add all of this damage together before applying damage reduction from Guard or abilities.

name: Wire Sweep
description: You whip your wire to ensnare the target. If they fail their save against your Potency+2 they are rendered Prone and take Light Damage.
requirement: Saboteur Threaded Dagger only.

name: Wither the Stalk
description:
You strike an enemy with an attack that saps their strength. You make a Light attack against the target. On damage, the target cannot add their Power for damage to their next attack.

Does not work against Boss enemies.
requirement: Scythe only

name: X-Attack
description: You give your summon a +1 Focus and +1 Power buff.
requirement: Can only target your summoned animal.

name: Zap
description: You may make a Light attack against the target, dealing Lightning damage. On damage, inflict Static X where X equals your Focus X 3.

name: Zhen Jiao
description: When you move toward an enemy as part of a Martial Artist or Bajiquan ability due to Fire Stance or an inherent move effect of the ability (such as Rushing Knee Drop), your attack deals three extra points of damage for every 5ft moved. If your attack hits more than once or more than one target, you only apply this damage once.

name: Name
benefits: Benefits

name: Acolyte's Journey
benefits: You gain proficiency in light armor, shields and a single common group of weapons. This group may include Channeling Weapons, even though they aren't consider common weapons. (But you only get 1 of the possible channeling weapons). | You gain +5 skill points in the Religion skill. You can exchange any skill point for 2 expertise points, but must spend them in this skill. | You are welcome at establishments for your religion and they are obligated to help you with lodging, advice, food and sometimes equipment. | Upon Mastery of the class, you gain Elemental Mastery in your chosen Divine's element (or Holy if just human).

name: Advanced Artificing
benefits: You gain Artificer Advanced Crafting Abilities | You are able to craft artifices that cost 10000 clim or less. | You gain +1 Burden that must be spent on an artifice.

name: Adventurer Essentials
benefits: You gain proficiency in 1 common weapon group. In addition, you gain proficiency in 1 common or specialized weapon groups. | You gain proficiency in 1 armor category of your choosing. Alternatively, you may pick the shield or greatshield. | You may use Presence Concealment.

name: Aerial Mage
