benefits: You may use Aerial Mode Switch. | While grounded and riding an Aerial Stave, you may reload 2 shells instead of 1 when taking the Reload Artifice basic action on your staff. You may do this even if your hands would normally be full and can draw both shells with 1 action.

name: Aftershocks
benefits: You may use Aftershock. | When using a Fighter, Highlander or Reaver ability that compares Power against a Boss type enemy, you may treat your Power as 2 higher for that purpose. (Does not affect the dmg roll etc)

name: Air Stability
benefits: The cavalier’s Rider & Mount As One ability applies even while flying. Any damage you take while flying on a flying mount will cause you to lose altitude as if your mount took damage.

name: Angelic Presence
benefits: You gain Angelic Presence, which gives a +1 to Presence.

name: Armorsmith Basics
benefits: You gain proficiency in light armor, medium armor and shields. | You gain proficiency in 1 basic melee weapon and can use a smith's hammer as a bludgeoning weapon in which you are proficient. | You can craft armors, shields and cloaks using Iron, Tamahagane, Animal Hide and Direhide, as well as alloys. You may use an IP to perform an EP action tied to this key ability 4 times. | You gain Armorsmith Core Crafting abilities.

name: Armorsmithing Expert
benefits: You gain the Master Armorer's core crafting abilities | You may craft using Mithril, Orihalcum, Primehide and Dragonscale materials.

name: Arms Mastery
benefits: You are considered proficient with every melee weapon you wield (This does not count as being proficient for class requirements).

name: Artificer Basics
benefits: You gain Artificer Core Crafting Abilities | You can craft using non-advanced materials and base materials. You may use an IP to perform an EP action tied to this key ability 4 times. | You can now craft Artifices and Firearms. You are able to craft artifices that cost 2500 clim or less. | You gain proficiency in the musket and the Artificer's Multitool.

name: Augmented Casting - Increased Reach
benefits: You may use Increased Reach.

name: Augmented Casting - Persistent Spell
benefits: You may use Persistent Spell.

name: Authority
benefits: You may treat any roll on Negotiation and Intimidation checks that are below 10 as being a 10 and may spend 2 mana before rolling to treat the roll as a 20 instead. | One of your eyes becomes an Domination Eye. It may be used to make Mystic Eye type abilities of the appropriate type. An eye can only be a single mystic eye type.

name: Benevolence
benefits: You gain Elemental Mastery: Holy | Your attacks do not consume Illumination on miss. | You may choose not to use the effect of Illumination on a target.(Must be declared before an attack is made).

name: Bone Armor
benefits: You may use Bone Armor.

name: Botany Study
benefits: You gain the ability to detect if foraged food is poisonous or unsafe to eat, nearly guaranteeing its safety.  If it is a common poison, you can also identify its effect. | You gain the ability to properly process some poisonous mushrooms, fruits and herbs, making them edible as a Camp Action.  You can process up to 100u at a time. | You gain the ability to harvest Tier 2 Foraging Outcrops. | You gain proficiency in Artifice Chainsaws and may use it as a gathering tool.

name: Boundless Wind
benefits: You may use Boundless Wind Stance.

name: Brace
benefits: When using the Prepare action to prepare a melee attack with a polearm, if your target of that prepared attack moved more than 20ft that turn (excluding teleports), your attack gains Full Pierce and does maximum damage. Against a mounted enemy this also gains Sure Hit and on damage, their movement becomes 0 until the start of your turn. | On mastering this class, the Sure Hit property (but not the movement nullification) of your prepared attack against mounted enemies now also applies against Beast type enemies that are large size or bigger.

name: Cannon Expert
benefits: You gain proficiency in Cannons. | Your attacks with the Cannon keyword ignore the 1 attack limitation of cannons. | You may use Rocket Jump.

name: Carpenter Basics
benefits: You can use a carpenters chisel as a crafting tool for carpenters crafts and buildings. | You can craft using Pine and Maple, as well as alloys. You may use an IP to perform an EP action tied to this key ability 4 times. | You gain proficiency in axes. You also gain proficiency in either bows or crossbows. | You can use the Carpenter's core crafting abilities.

name: Celestial Artillery
benefits: When attacking an enemy outdoors that’s further than 80ft away, your spells with the Celestial keyword gain the Artillery keyword. | You may use Comet.

name: Cloudstep
benefits: You may use Cloudstep.

name: Controlled Blaze
benefits: When you deal Fire Damage, you may choose not to ignite flammable objects. | You gain Fire Mastery.

name: Controlled Opportunities
benefits: You gain Heavy Armor proficiency. | When making an attack of opportunity, you gain a +2 bonus to the accuracy and damage roll.

name: Controlled Wind
benefits: When pushing a target back or up with a Wind Spell, you may choose to push up to the maximum distance instead of always pushing the maximum distance.

name: Cool Spotlight
benefits: Your Idol songs gain +15ft range.  This stacks with other key abilities that increase their range. | Your One Beat, One Heart song does not count towards your song limit. | When paying upkeep for One Beat, One Heart, you may spend 1 mana to double its effect.

name: Craft Weapons
benefits: You gain Blacksmith Core Crafting Abilities. | You can craft using the Iron and Tamahagane base materials, as well as any alloys. You may use an IP to perform an EP action tied to this key ability 4 times. | You can use a Smith’s Hammer as a crafting tool for blacksmithing crafts. You may also use it as a Bludgeoning weapon in which you are proficient. | You gain proficiency in 1 smithing weapon.

name: Culinary Basics
benefits: You gain Culinarian Core Crafting Abilities | You can craft stocks using advanced and base materials. You may use an IP to perform an EP action tied to this key ability 4 times. | You can use a Frying Pan as a crafting tool for culinarian crafts. You may also use it as a Light Bludgeoning weapon in which you are proficient. | You gain proficiency in small weapons.

name: Cultivator's Journey
benefits: Your unarmed attack damage is treated as a One-Handed Weapon in which you are proficient. | You gain proficiency in light armor, light swords and another weapon of your choice. | You gain +5 skill points to spend in Appraise, Athletics, Deception, Perception, Insight, Medicine, Intimidation, Stealth or Common Knowledge. You can exchange any skill point for 2 expertise points, but must spend them in these skills.

name: Dark Surge
benefits: After you deal damage to yourself, you gain Dark Surge for your next unarmed attack that turn. Dark Surge gives you +1 Accuracy.

name: Dark Weapon
benefits: When attacking with a weapon, you may choose to have the weapon deal Dark Damage instead of its normal damage type. You must declare your chosen damage type before making the accuracy roll.

name: Death Perception
benefits: You may use Death Perception. | One of your eyes becomes a Shinigami Eye. It may be used to make Mystic Eye type abilities of the appropriate type. An eye can only be a single mystic eye type.

name: Deflect Everything
benefits: You may use your Parry ability against every kind of attack, as well as against Save effects that you could Block.

name: Dimensional Armory
benefits: You can create a pocket dimension with Dimensional Armory.  Creating the pocket dimension and establishing its door takes 1 week and costs 1 errand point.  The entry point can be any regular door that you fit through.  When the creator opens this door, they can decide instead to access the Dimensional Armory, which is a 15ft x 15ft closet.  This closet can hold up to 6 Burden worth of items.  Some magic items can be rejected by the dimensional armory (GM’s discretion), such as Divine Arms not bonded to you.  If the owner of a Dimensional Armory dies, everything inside of it appears in the next unoccupied space possible next to the owner. | Any burden reducing items (such as an alchemy rig) in the armory have no effect. Materials can be stored in the armory at the cost of 1 slot per 1000u of materials.

name: Disable Magic
benefits: When using Decipher Magic, you are able to disable both tier 1 and tier 2 level bounded fields. | You are able to disable or change who is excluded from your own Bounded Fields for 0 RP.

name: Discern Immunities
benefits: You may use Discern Immunities.

name: Divine Weapon
benefits: When attacking with a weapon, you may choose to have the weapon deal the damage of your chosen Divine instead. You must declare your chosen damage type before making the accuracy roll. | You may choose to have your weapon emit light as if it was a lantern. You can enable or disable this effect for 1 AP.

name: Draw Elements
benefits: You may use Draw Elements.

name: Draw Elements II
benefits: You may use Draw Elements II.

name: Earth Weapon
benefits: When attacking with a weapon, you may choose to have the weapon deal Earth Damage instead of its normal damage type. You must declare you chosen damage type before making the accuracy roll.

name: Elemental Convergence
benefits: You may use Elemental Convergence.

name: Emergency Shields
benefits: You may cast Power Word: Shield and Power Word: Guardian Shield (when obtained) by spending 1 RP instead of 2 AP.
